concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 3D production character reference sheet. Show the SAME small Final Fantasy IX inspired black mage in three full-body views, front three-quarter, side, back. Refined modern stylized game sculpture, warm late-1990s JRPG charm, timid curious personality. Oversized weathered warm ochre linen pointed wizard hat, very broad soft uneven floppy brim, tall asymmetrically bent tip, creases, modest dark leather hatband. Beneath the brim is a completely shadow-black recessed oval face with only two warm luminous yellow oval eyes; NO human face, no nose, no mouth, no beard, no skin. Compact childlike proportions around 1.5 metres INCLUDING tall hat; small shoulders, rounded continuous soft cloth body and limbs. Long worn indigo-blue coat with high cream turned collar, layered lapels, subtle buttons, loose full sleeves and thick ivory glove mitts; coat hem ends just above knees and opens slightly at front to reveal tan subtly striped loose trousers. Modest worn brown ankle boots with round toe, soft creases and continuous ankle shape. No staff, weapons, belts of equipment or large effects. Cloth folds must define volume naturally, never primitive cones or cylinders glued together. Matte fine woven cloth, understated leather, no plastic gloss, no metal armour. Keep hat silhouette, big brim, glowing eyes, blue coat, loose sleeves and soft boots clearly readable and consistent across all views. Neutral warm grey background, soft shadows, full character including hat tip and soles framed with breathing room. No text, labels, logos, UI, scenes or extra figures.
atlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square four-quadrant cloth COLOR TEXTURE ATLAS for a stylized 3D Final Fantasy IX black mage. Four equally sized square tiles touching, precisely a 2 by 2 grid. Top-left worn muted indigo blue woven coat fabric. Top-right weathered warm golden ochre linen hat fabric. Bottom-left plain warm ivory coarse canvas for collar and gloves. Bottom-right pale tan trouser cloth with widely spaced very thin faded brown vertical pinstripes. Each quadrant is a flat, evenly lit, orthographic closeup of its material, fine understated weave and subtle mottled wear only. NO scene, objects, drapery, folds, seams, shadows, bevels, highlights, text, labels, borders, gaps or decorative symbols. Texture not a photograph of four fabric swatches. Full bleed colors in each quadrant, interiors uniform enough to tile across a garment. High quality hand painted game texture, restrained micro detail, soft cloth not glitter or marble. Must keep the exact quadrant arrangement.
